page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of RAM, offering a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. It does not include local storage or attached GPUs. Applications requiring persistent storage must rely on external network-attached storage volumes. Additionally, the instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, high vCPU core count, and 160 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, the ecs.g7nex.32xlarge delivers a high-density general-purpose resource profile. This configuration is suitable for large-scale enterprise applications, high-traffic web server fleets, and distributed systems that demand substantial network throughput without requiring local NVMe storage or specialized hardware acceleration.
